title: Spread Limit for an Added Invoice by Patient Standing
content:
**Patient Payment Plans — schedule of spread limits for an added invoice**

The installments an added invoice may be spread over are capped by the patient's standing: at no more than 18 for a patient with an approved financial-assistance award, at no more than 12 for a patient with no approved award and at least 6 scheduled installments paid less than 12 whole months before today, and at no more than 9 for any other patient; the cap applies to the installments counted or still to fall due before any add-on extension months are added.

| Patient's standing | Most installments the added invoice may be spread over |
|---|---|
| Approved award under the Patient Financial Assistance Program | 18 |
| No approved award; 6 or more scheduled installments paid in the last 12 whole months | 12 |
| No approved award; 5 or fewer scheduled installments paid in that span | 9 |

**Records read.** An *approved award* is a case of the patient under the Patient Financial Assistance Program whose status is approved. *Scheduled installments paid* are payments on the plan ledger posted as scheduled installments and dated less than 12 whole months before today.

**Order of the cap.** The cap is applied to the installments counted for the plan, or to the installments still to fall due under the term, and only afterwards are any add-on extension months added.

## Hypothetical applications

- A patient with an approved award on an 18-Month Payment Plan with 15 installments still to fall due: the spread runs over 15, which is within 18.
- A patient with no award, 7 scheduled installments paid in the span, 15 still to fall due: the spread is held to 12.
- A patient with no award, 4 paid in the span, 15 still to fall due: held to 9.
- A patient with no award, 5 paid in the span, 9 still to fall due, on a term with 3 add-on extension months where the extension applies: held to 9 first, then 3 added, 12 in all.
